name: px-pixelart
title: Pixel Art
description: A very basic pixel-picture maker: choose how many rows and columns, then colour the squares.
audience: Anyone who wants to make a small pixel picture on a phone or a computer, without an account or a drawing program.
useCases: A child picks a 16 × 16 grid on a parent's phone, colours a pixel heart square by square, and saves it to show later
Someone planning a cross-stitch or bead pattern sets the exact rows and columns, fills the background in one go with "Pick all", and keeps several versions with Save as new
A designer copies a brand colour code from another app and pastes it into the colour window to use the exact shade
A teacher sketches a simple pixel icon for a lesson on a laptop, saves it, and opens it again the next day to finish it, offline

dataPrivacy.storage: The picture being drawn and every saved picture are kept in the browser's local storage, on the device only.
dataPrivacy.transmission: Nothing is sent anywhere. Once loaded, the app works with the network switched off.
dataPrivacy.thirdParty: None at runtime. The clipboard is read only when Paste is tapped, and only with the browser's permission.
